help:
agentic-flow-kit v{{version}}

用法：
  flow-kit install --agent <host> [--agent <host>...] [--lang zh-CN|en] [--stack dotnet|node|typescript|rust|go|java|empty] [--surface frontend|api|data] [--tier lean|standard|enterprise] [--hardened] [--target <dir>] [--model [host:]role=<id>] [--model-mode recommend|detect|inherit] [--probe-models] [--no-model-config] [--dry-run] [--force] [--json] [--strict] [--auto-hosts] [--no-git-config] [--track-hosts] [--no-mcp] [--baseline|--no-baseline]
  flow-kit add-host <host> [--target <dir>] [--model [host:]role=<id>] [--model-mode recommend|detect|inherit] [--probe-models] [--no-model-config] [--dry-run] [--force] [--json] [--strict] [--baseline|--no-baseline]
  flow-kit upgrade [--target <dir>] [--explain-policy] [--model [host:]role=<id>] [--model-mode recommend|detect|inherit] [--probe-models] [--dry-run] [--force] [--json] [--strict] [--baseline|--no-baseline]
  flow-kit adopt [--target <dir>] [--agent <host>...] [--lang zh-CN|en] [--stack <name>] [--tier lean|standard|enterprise] [--hardened] [--dry-run] [--json]
  flow-kit prune [--target <dir>] [--dry-run] [--force] [--json] [--strict] [--baseline]
  flow-kit remove-host <host> [--target <dir>] [--dry-run] [--force] [--json] [--strict]
  flow-kit uninstall [--target <dir>] [--dry-run] [--force] [--json] [--strict]
  flow-kit diff [--target <dir>] [--json] [--strict] [--all]
  flow-kit status [--target <dir>] [--json] [--strict]
  flow-kit workspace init --repos <dir>... [--target <dir>] [--json]
  flow-kit workspace status [--target <dir>] [--json]
  flow-kit explain <targetRel> [--target <dir>] [--json]
  flow-kit doctor [--target <dir>] [--deep] [--fix] [--json]
  flow-kit list-hosts [--json]

--host-manifest <file>：加载外部宿主定义（可重复）；也自动读取 .flow-kit/hosts/*.json 与 ~/.flow-kit/hosts/*.json，优先级 项目 > 用户 > 内置。
--json：stdout 只输出单个 JSON 对象，人类进度写入 stderr。
--strict：冲突或漂移（install/add-host/upgrade 的冲突，diff/status/prune 的未清理项）返回 1。
退出码：0 成功、1 冲突/严格模式漂移、2 用法错误、3 目标或 manifest 缺失、4 未知宿主、5 IO 失败。

宿主：trae, codebuddy, claude, opencode, qwen, pi, cline, commandcode, qoder, zcode

模型角色：code（实现）/ judgment（判断）/ review（独立复核，建议与 code 不同）

示例：
  node cli-tools/agentic-flow-kit/bin/flow-kit.mjs install --agent claude --lang zh-CN --model claude:code=haiku --model claude:review=opus --target .
